title: Compose both P104 scalar rewrites with a complete error budget
body:
The selected P104 prefix and chart127 suffix now form one checked 19,107-event word. Its real scalar allowance is 140,268. The incremental gain over CubeJerry's stronger prefix-only predecessor is 119 events and 2,510 allowance units; the larger 3,696-event/49,160-unit difference from selected PR6030 includes inherited work.

The independent checker compares both complete arbitrary-entry block operators (618,514 coefficients), all four full word bills, and all 638,401 joined transpose coefficients. Protected native/COPY/INIT/CLEAR events, all 770 public inputs, 29 owned fields, 31 lifetimes, peak 13 owned roles, and the complete target/paid profiles stay fixed. Six semantic faults reject. Both source searches reproduce the committed blocks.

The joined circuit also improves the causal error bound: below 0.829 B at 16 uniform guard bits, compared with 0.913 B for the selected word. The prefix-only bound is about 0.828916 B, while the joined bound is about 0.828177 B. All prefixes stay below 1024 B. The relative-defect model retains unitary native maps and exact COPY/reset; a failed sufficient guard is not a physical lower bound.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal/optimized checks, committed bytes/modes and official export pass at `a96bbab7b4849d744b7070ddd48014d14bd412fa`. Read-only Git-free, empty-PATH normal/optimized replay passes. Hosted CI is pending. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout; every live source comes from the immediate main parent and is included in the export.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-composed-scalar-blocks`.

No new kappa, physical backend, native theorem or selected-frontier change. The next step is a fully priced rounded backend. The task card scope change and family stop are explicit in TASK.json: the recursive signed moment is unchanged.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19363323). Canonical main, revision 8, handoffs and current PRs were refreshed before submission. Credit CubeJerry/PR6116 for the prefix, Nick Petalas for the suffix and its open composition question, DreamingOfClouds/PR6030, David Arias, Cinna Davis, Gareth Davidson, Ali Romman and the retained P104/native/compiler lineage. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
